rule: no NaN in any journey or shipment column outside the declared nullable set ['match_score', 'matched_shipment_ids']
action_if_violated: flag row, do not drop; investigate generator branch

rule: match_score is populated if and only if the truck was matched
action_if_violated: score written for an unmatched truck -> bookkeeping fault

rule: (scenario, instance, policy, truck) is unique in journeys
action_if_violated: keep first, log the duplicate key

rule: distances, fuel, cost and times are non-negative
action_if_violated: quarantine row; a negative here is a code fault, not data noise
recompute from legs; never patch the aggregate

rule: total = variable + fixed; variable = fuel + driver + toll
action_if_violated: recompute in CostModel; single source of truth
>100% means payload exceeded capacity -> capacity constraint broken

rule: payload tonne-km never exceeds capacity tonne-km
action_if_violated: hard constraint violation; reject the route

rule: delivery deadline is strictly after pickup ready time
action_if_violated: regenerate the shipment; an inverted window is unservable

rule: all coordinates inside the Indian bounding box (6-38N, 68-98E)
action_if_violated: drop node from the network; a stray coordinate corrupts every matrix
regenerate; a zero-length shipment is meaningless

rule: shipments served never exceeds shipments offered
every policy in an instance saw the same shipment pool (the paired-design precondition)
action_if_violated: instance regenerated between policies -> pairing broken, analysis void
